program.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
requirements.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcomes.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcomes.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

nodes.question: Does the edited image render the depicted forms with drawing-like contours, rather than retaining the source image’s photographic or otherwise non-drawing representation?
nodes.criteria: Pass if, compared with the source, the edited image visibly represents the depicted forms through drawn contours or linework characteristic of a drawing. Fail if the source’s non-drawing representation remains, or if any apparent change is only a grain or filter effect without drawing-like contours. Unknown only if the relevant contours cannot be observed.
nodes.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing
nodes.endpoint: The image’s depicted forms are represented as a drawing, with visibly drawn contours or linework.
nodes.necessity: The instruction explicitly requests a drawing, so a drawing-like representation is necessary; without it, the requested transformation is incomplete.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly render its surfaces with a chalk-like appearance, rather than merely adding grain or a filter to the source image?
nodes.criteria: Pass if, compared with the source, visible surface marks or tonal treatment make the image read as rendered with chalk. Fail if the source’s surface appearance remains or the only change is generic grain or filtering that does not produce a chalk-like rendering. Unknown only if the surface treatment cannot be observed.
nodes.endpoint: The drawing has visibly chalk-like surface marks or tonal treatment.
nodes.necessity: The instruction specifies that the drawing is made from chalk; a drawing without a visibly chalk-like rendering does not fulfill that requested material appearance.

These are distinct visual dimensions: drawn contours establish that the image is a drawing, while chalk-like surface rendering establishes the requested material appearance. Either can be absent while the other is present, so two independent endpoint conditions are justified.

nodes.question: Compared with the source, are the depicted forms rendered as a drawing across their interiors and contours, rather than retaining substantial photographic detail beneath outlines or filtering?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the depicted forms are visibly rendered as drawn forms across their interiors and contours. Fail if substantial photographic-looking surface detail remains and the drawing effect is mainly outlines, blur, or filtering. Unknown only if the relevant forms cannot be observed.
nodes.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing
nodes.endpoint: The depicted forms are rendered as a drawing, rather than substantially retained as photographic forms with an effect applied.
nodes.necessity: The instruction requests turning the image into a drawing; contours alone do not establish that the depicted forms have been transformed into a drawing representation.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly render its surfaces with a chalk-like appearance, rather than merely adding grain or a filter to the source image?
nodes.criteria: Pass if, compared with the source, visible surface marks or tonal treatment make the image read as rendered with chalk. Fail if the source’s surface appearance remains or the only change is generic grain or filtering that does not produce a chalk-like rendering. Unknown only if the surface treatment cannot be observed.
nodes.endpoint: The drawing has visibly chalk-like surface marks or tonal treatment.
nodes.necessity: The instruction specifies that the drawing is made from chalk; a drawing without a visibly chalk-like rendering does not fulfill that requested material appearance.

nodes.question: Compared with the source, do the main depicted forms themselves—the giraffes—visibly receive chalk-like surface marks or tonal treatment, rather than retaining their photographic coat detail while the background is chalk-like?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the giraffes’ interiors visibly show chalk-like marks or tonal treatment across their surfaces. Fail if the chalk-like treatment is confined mainly to the background and the giraffes retain substantially photographic coat patterns and shading. Unknown only if the giraffes’ surface treatment cannot be judged.
nodes.aspect: chalk rendering on main depicted forms
nodes.endpoint: The main depicted forms themselves have visibly chalk-like surface rendering.
